baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus construction links asking, recompense, binding liability, and being made heavy through a resultative fa.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative constructs a denied causal chain: a request for work-payment would create an owed charge, and that charge would become a load that slows or impairs the addressees. Material incapacity is therefore staged as a possible excuse and tested rather than assumed.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting supplies the initiating demand and positions the messenger as a possible claimant.
Recompense for work supplies the consideration that could turn communication into an exchange.
Binding financial liability converts the requested consideration into an enforceable debit rather than a casual inconvenience.
Heaviness against lightness gives the debit a felt load and completes the proposed causal chain.
Sluggishness and impairment make the alleged load capable of explaining delayed or blocked response.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are simply described as finding a requested payment too burdensome.
changed_reading.after: The verse tests a full excuse mechanism: did the messenger create a payable obligation whose weight actually disabled response?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from requested wage to gharim relation makes the social positions created by payment as important as the amount.
baseline_models.mechanism: A wage request would install a creditor-debtor relation: the messenger would become claimant and the audience obligated payers. Because the liability branch can name either side of that tie, the question audits whether proclamation has created an unwanted relation of claim and answerability, with heaviness marking its asymmetry.

activation_trace.role: Requesting establishes the speech act by which one party could place a claim on another.
Contract-like recompense supplies the exchange relation around which claimant and payer roles form.
The creditor-debtor tie supplies a two-sided social bond and shifts attention from price size to imposed relation.
Heaviness marks which side of the relation allegedly bears its pressure.

changed_reading.before: The question asks whether the audience can afford a fee.
changed_reading.after: The question asks whether the message has conscripted the audience into any creditor-debtor relation at all.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wage, liability, and measured weight form an accounting cluster inside the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The requested recompense supplies a unit of exchange, the liability supplies a debit, and standard weighing supplies assessment. The interrogative therefore resembles an audit: identify the consideration, show the booked obligation, and measure the alleged load before treating cost as an explanation.

activation_trace.role: The request opens the proposed account by naming a possible demand.
Work-payment supplies the account's proposed consideration.
Financial liability supplies the debit that would have to be demonstrated.
Standard weight and weighing turn vague hardship into an assessable alleged balance.

changed_reading.before: The verse evokes a generic sense of expensive preaching.
changed_reading.after: The verse demands an account: what was requested, what liability followed, and what measurable load resulted?

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier occurrence of the same wage root relocates recompense away from the audience. Negated cutting makes that recompense non-diminishing, while negated favor-burden prevents it from becoming leverage over its recipient. The focus question consequently denies not only a fee but the whole human patronage structure that could make hearers debtors and the messenger beholden.

activation_trace.role: The focus work-payment is the alleged charge whose source is being tested.
The focus liability supplies the burden that an audience-funded wage would create.
The same work-recompense image places a prior wage on the messenger's side of the relation.
Negation and exclusion block the following cutting and favor-burden images from qualifying that recompense.
Cutting and diminution supply the endpoint that the earlier reward explicitly does not reach.
Burdening a beneficiary by invoking a favor supplies the patronage pressure that the negation removes.

structural_cues: The same wage root occurs at 68:3 and 68:46, first as assured recompense and later as a hypothetical audience charge.
The focus resultative fa stages the fee-to-burden chain that the earlier negated qualification has already undercut.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relocated recompense, negation, non-cutting, and favor-as-burden; I infer separate sourcing and freedom from human patronage, while the live narrower alternative is only that the messenger's reward is perpetual.

changed_reading.before: The messenger may be waiving an otherwise ordinary audience fee.
changed_reading.after: His recompense is already constituted outside the audience and cannot be weaponized as a favor, so no human debt relation ever needs to arise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding interrogative sequence assembles a tribunal: judgment, an inscription capable of imposing a ruling, study of that instrument, a durable oath, questioning, and a guarantor. Against that apparatus, the focus ayah reverses the direction of claim. Those who implied that a binding entitlement ran in their favor are asked whether the messenger instead holds a wage claim that makes them debtors. Neither direction of obligation survives without an instrument or surety.

activation_trace.role: The focus request continues the act of demanding that a claim be stated and tested.
The two-sided creditor-debtor tie makes reversal of claimant and obligated party mechanically possible.
Judgment between parties supplies the tribunal frame in which obligations are examined.
An inscription that imposes judgment supplies the missing instrument for their asserted entitlement.
Tracking a book through reading and retention supplies the examination required to locate the alleged clause.
The sworn oath supplies a second possible source of binding entitlement.
Reaching an endpoint gives the proposed oath a claimed term extending to the final day.
Direct questioning turns the entitlement claim into cross-examination immediately before the focus question.
Undertaking a guarantee supplies the surety whose identity the examination demands.

structural_cues: Ayat 68:36-40 move in sequence from judgment to book, oath, questioning, and guarantor.
Repeated alternative interrogatives carry that examination forward into the fee question at 68:46.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjudication, binding inscription, study, oath, term, questioning, and surety; I infer one continuing claim audit, while a live alternative treats the questions as independent challenges with no single docket.

changed_reading.before: The audience is imagined only as a payer unable to meet the messenger's price.
changed_reading.after: The verse flips a formal claim audit: after their unsupported entitlement is tested, it asks whether any valid claim runs the other way and makes them debtors.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence materializes an economy of imagined outgoing cost. Wealth holders coordinate by oath, cut the harvest, and bar the poor person so that no share leaves their control; the attempt to prevent loss ends in their own deprivation. The focus fee question can therefore expose projection: people trained to treat another's access as a charge imagine that hearing the message must also put them in debt, although the actual liability is generated by withholding.

activation_trace.role: The focus recompense supplies the outgoing payment that the scarcity model projects onto proclamation.
Binding liability supplies the feared loss that withholding is meant to avoid and then ironically creates.
Holding the hand back from giving supplies the social disposition behind the imagined cost.
Accumulating abundant wealth supplies the setting in which inability-to-pay is exposed as a weak explanation.
An oath apportioned among its participants supplies coordinated commitment to the exclusion plan.
Harvest cutting supplies the controlled removal of produce around which access and shares are contested.
Gathering, earning, and work make the garden yield a material counterpart to wage and recompense.
The humiliation of poverty identifies the excluded person whose entry is treated as a drain on the yield.
Prevention and withdrawal supply the owners' operational means of retaining the crop.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the desired good reverse the intended exclusion onto the owners.

structural_cues: The narrative runs from a plan to exclude a poor entrant to the planners' declaration that they themselves are deprived.
The garden economy precedes the focus question and repeatedly couples possession, cutting, prevention, and lost yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, accumulated wealth, coordinated oath, harvest-work, poverty, prevention, and reversed deprivation; I infer that this narrative acts as a material analogy for the imagined fee, while the live alternative is only a broader critique of wealth-driven refusal.

changed_reading.before: The addressees resist because receiving the message may cost them money.
changed_reading.after: Their fee objection is a scarcity projection: the message takes no share, while their own practice of withholding manufactures the loss and liability they fear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in supplies stepwise taking, extended time, deliberate strategy, and hard continuity. Those images convert the focus contrast into one between a nonexistent up-front admission price and a real consequence that accrues during respite. Delay is not an empty account; it is the temporal medium in which persistent liability gains weight.

activation_trace.role: Persistent affliction lets liability extend beyond a one-time bill into a consequence that remains attached.
Heaviness supplies the cumulative load produced by the temporal process.
Taking degree by degree supplies incremental rather than immediate accumulation.
Extended time and respite supply the interval across which the liability can accrue.
Strategy and concealed handling make the delayed process intentional rather than accidental drift.
Extended solidity gives the delayed process tensile firmness and prevents respite from meaning release.

structural_cues: Ayat 68:44-45 immediately precede the focus ayah and move from gradual taking to respite and firm strategy.
The focus alternative interrogative follows that temporal process with a denied monetary explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incremental taking, respite, strategy, solidity, persistent affliction, and weight; I supply the arrow from temporal extension to accrued load, while the live alternative is that the lead-in names punishment without any accounting analogy.

changed_reading.before: No demanded fee means the audience carries no cost.
changed_reading.after: The verse denies an up-front fee while the immediate context exposes a different account: consequence accumulates quietly during the very respite that looks cost-free.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes access, capacity, and compliance. They are called, later cannot act, had previously been sound, are overtaken by an imposition that weighs, and finally hear without the understanding-obedience branch becoming effective. This activates the focus heaviness as a proposed impairment: the question is not merely whether payment hurts but whether any imposed charge actually made response impossible. The context answers with a transition from available capacity to culpable incapacity, not cash shortage.

activation_trace.role: Sluggishness and impairment turn focus heaviness into a candidate cause of non-response.
Dullness of hearing makes reception itself, not only finances, a possible site of the alleged load.
Calling by speech supplies an offered summons against which response capacity can be observed.
Ability and capacity supply the explicit variable whose loss needs explanation.
Soundness and freedom from defect establish that an earlier opportunity for response was intact.
An imposition that weighs supplies the later pressure that overtakes them after prior capacity.
Understanding and compliance distinguish fruitful hearing from mere acoustic exposure at the later encounter.

structural_cues: The sequence contrasts a past call while sound with a later call they cannot answer.
After the focus ayah, hearing the reminder produces hostility rather than compliant understanding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, capacity, prior soundness, a weighing imposition, and hearing-as-compliance; I infer a moral transition from capacity to incapacity, while the live alternative keeps the later inability eschatological and semantically separate from focus debt.

changed_reading.before: The hypothetical burden is exclusively financial.
changed_reading.after: The financial clause tests a broader excuse of disablement: did any charge make them unable to answer, or did refused capacity harden into the later inability?

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent alternative question moves from an alleged audience charge to possession of concealed knowledge that they themselves record. Fee and hidden writing become rival economies of access: perhaps the public message is rejected because it costs them, or perhaps they claim a proprietary source that outranks it. With neither a bill from the messenger nor a binding hidden record in their hands, both external justifications collapse.

activation_trace.role: Work-payment supplies the proposed price of access in the first alternative.
Binding liability supplies the claimed exclusionary consequence of that price.
Concealment from sight supplies the allegedly private source of knowledge in the second alternative.
Joining letters into a written record supplies their claimed means of fixing concealed knowledge.
An inscription that imposes judgment supplies the authority their hidden record would need but is not shown to possess.

structural_cues: Ayat 68:46 and 68:47 are adjacent alternative interrogatives.
The first proposes a price-debt barrier; the second proposes concealed possession and writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a requested wage, liability, concealed knowledge, and writing with binding force; I infer two rival access economies, while the live alternative reads the adjacent questions as unrelated excuses rather than a fee-versus-proprietary-knowledge pair.

changed_reading.before: The fee question concerns only material affordability.
changed_reading.after: It is one half of an access audit: neither a paywall imposed by the messenger nor a proprietary hidden ledger can explain or authorize rejection.

It remains anchored to the focus request and its fee-liability-load chain. Downstream prose should call it a latent material analogy, never a direct lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The request at focus word 2 initiates the causal path toward fee, liability, and heaviness.

activation_trace.role: Gentle hidden drawing-out recasts asking as quietly extracting value from the audience.
Secret taking sharpens the feared fee into covert appropriation rather than open exchange.
Wasting illness supplies depletion as the bodily endpoint of the imagined extraction.
Work-payment gives the extraction analogy a visible transactional anchor.
Sluggish impairment supplies the depleted condition attributed to being covertly charged.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies an openly requested fee.
changed_reading.after: At the level of latent imagery, it also tests the accusation that proclamation quietly siphons resources or strength from its hearers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because precious weight pulls against the dominant syntax of being burdened by liability. It remains anchored in the focus weight branch and is sharpened by the later right-document and reminder branches. Downstream prose should preserve it only as a contrastive undertone: alleged costly weight versus actual value-weight.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus participle of heaviness can activate assessed worth as well as oppressive load, although the liability phrase favors the latter.

activation_trace.role: Recompense supplies the price against which worth can be mistakenly measured.
Financial liability supplies the dominant negative weight that this outlier does not erase.
Preciousness and high worth introduce a countercurrent in which weight can signal value rather than only oppression.
A right fixed as deed or document gives the reminder juridical weight without turning it into a human invoice.
The reminder that makes one remember supplies the valuable content being misread as costly demand.

changed_reading.before: All weight in the verse is the oppressive weight of a bill.
changed_reading.after: A faint counterreading contrasts the imaginary price-weight imposed on hearers with the real worth and documentary weight of the freely given reminder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain spatial activation: monetary heaviness at the focus is read beside later attempted dislodgment by sight. It remains valid because the focus asks who actually bears pressure and the later scene supplies an observable outward force after hearing. Downstream prose should present it as a narrative reversal of force, not as a gloss of debt vocabulary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus resultative chain assigns the alleged load to the audience, making the direction of pressure inspectable.

activation_trace.role: Persistent affliction supplies the inward pressure the audience is alleged to bear.
Heaviness fixes the initial vector of force downward onto the addressees.
Slipping an object from its station converts response into an outward attempt to destabilize the messenger.
Physical sight supplies the channel through which the destabilizing force is projected.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the response pathway that turns instead into hostility.
The reminder supplies the actual trigger for the later displacement attempt without any fee intervening.

changed_reading.before: A fee would press inward on the audience and explain their refusal.
changed_reading.after: When the reminder is actually heard for free, pressure runs outward: they try to dislodge its bearer, exposing threatened position rather than imposed debt.

strongest_changes: The earlier wage that is neither cut off nor used as favor-leverage relocates recompense away from the audience and dissolves the proposed fee-to-debt chain.
The judgment-book-oath-guarantor sequence turns the focus ayah into a reversal inside a formal claim audit, not a standalone comment on affordability.
The garden narrative and the immediate stepwise-respite sequence relocate real liability from an imposed admission fee to withholding and deferred consequence.
Capacity, prior soundness, weighing imposition, and later noncompliant hearing keep a second reading alive in which heaviness tests disablement rather than cash shortage.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots support several simultaneous economies: work-payment, creditor-debtor role creation, favor as social burden, a measured ledger, and persistent load. The split asking root also licenses a contained hidden-extraction image, while nearby narrative sequences reverse both the source and direction of burden.
remaining_uncertainties: The resultative fa can be heard as a tightly causal fee-to-load mechanism or as a looser consequence inside a denied hypothetical.
The garden's scarcity economy is a strong material analogy but the arrow from withholding produce to projecting a message fee is reader-supplied.
The transition from prior capacity to later inability may remain eschatological rather than feeding directly back into focus heaviness.
The non-dominant s-l-l mapping is packet-licensed activation material, not evidence that the ordinary asking form means extraction.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **No fee explains their refusal.** `س ء ل B001/B002` supplies requesting and the sought object; `ء ج ر B001` recompense for work; `غ ر م B001/B002` binding financial liability and creditor-debtor tie; and `ث ق ل B001/B006` heaviness and impairment. The question negates a transaction in which hearing the message incurs debt. I infer burden cannot explain their denial because no such charge exists; the ayah removes an economic excuse.
2. **The messenger's reward and their imagined burden diverge.** The root `ء ج ر B001` recalls the addressee's uncut reward in 68:3, while here the opponents are not its payers. I infer divine recompense does not create a human creditor relation; the ayah clarifies the economy of 68:3 by separating reward from audience fee.
3. **Persistent affliction as an exploratory secondary reading.** `غ ر م B003` supplies inescapable affliction, and `ث ق ل B006` includes overpowering sluggishness. The weak link is that the syntax most directly evokes financial burden. Still, the wider packet's refusal under delayed consequence activates an image of people behaving as though response were an oppressive, clinging load; this remains exploratory rather than replacing the fee reading.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:47 immediately substitutes another unsupported possibility, access to the unseen, after the fee explanation is rejected. 68:52 makes the lack of a fee functionally apt: a reminder directed to all peoples cannot depend on a private debtor relation with its first hearers.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A free message misheard as binding debt.** Fixed `تَسْأَلُهُمْ` activates `س ء ل B001` (asking), fixed `أَجْرًا` activates `ء ج ر B001` (recompense for work), fixed `مَغْرَم` activates `غ ر م B001` (binding financial liability), and fixed `مُثْقَلُون` activates `ث ق ل B001` (heaviness). The unseen-writing claim in 68:47 and the hearing-then-madness response in 68:51 supply evasive authorization and failed reception; I infer that treating address as an imposed fee gives them a rationale for making it heavy. The question strips away the economic cause they project onto their refusal.
2. **Financial heaviness becomes auditory heaviness.** Fixed `مُثْقَلُون` also activates `ث ق ل B009` (dullness of hearing). In 68:51 they physically hear the reminder yet answer with a madness label; I infer the arrow imagined liability → resistant listening, while the packet itself supplies only debt imagery and failed auditory uptake. Their alleged burden reads as an epistemic weight placed on the ear.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:51 supplied the diagnostic result: they hear the reminder but answer with the madness label. That later failed uptake activated auditory heaviness (`ث ق ل B009`) inside fixed `مُثْقَلُون`, converting imagined financial burden into resistant reception.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Obligation Acquires Weight, Price, and Market Form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A social or verbal demand becomes tangible when it attaches as debt, is measured as weight, or enters exchange as a price.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The rejected fee is surrounded by a full political economy of wages, debtors, standards, levies, markets, advance payment, charity, and emancipation installments.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Wage Becomes Attaching Debt and Surety
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Compensation is requested for work; if treated as liability, it adheres to debtor and creditor until a guarantor or installment discharges it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wage or contractual compensation (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m03`); financial charge (`quranic:root_001081:B001/m01`); creditor-debtor attachment (`quranic:root_001081:B002/m01`); lasting punitive liability (`quranic:root_001081:B003/m01`); guarantor (`quranic:root_000633:B003/m02`); manumission contract paid by installments (`quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Fee and debt are not synonyms. Wage compensates work, debt binds parties across time, guaranty reallocates default risk, and installments can turn payment into emancipation; 68:46 denies that this apparatus explains rejection.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Obligation Acquires Weight, Price, and Market Form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A social or verbal demand becomes tangible when it attaches as debt, is measured as weight, or enters exchange as a price.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The rejected fee is surrounded by a full political economy of wages, debtors, standards, levies, markets, advance payment, charity, and emancipation installments.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Weight and Valuation Make Burden Comparable
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A burden is placed on a scale, assigned a standard weight or price, and judged heavy, precious, slow, or equal.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: physical and figurative heaviness (`quranic:root_000202:B001/m01`); standard weight (`quranic:root_000202:B004/m01`); precious weighty object (`quranic:root_000202:B005/m01`); heaviness producing slowness (`quranic:root_000202:B006/m01`); hearing made unreceptive by weight (`quranic:root_000202:B009/m01`); pricing and valuation (`quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`); equal standard weight (`quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`); active market (`quranic:root_001273:B018/m01`); ounce as measured weight (`quranic:root_001677:B004/m01`); threshing as measured processing (`quranic:root_000470:B005/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Weight converts an attaching obligation into something comparable. The branches distinguish mass, standard, price, preciousness, delay, and impaired reception, showing how “burdened” can describe both economic pressure and a listener’s slowed response.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Perception Can Stabilize Knowledge or Strip Away Footing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sensory contact becomes reliable only when eye, ear, inward understanding, and stable bodily position cooperate.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Hostile looking is rendered as a literal destabilization of ground and skin, while hearing can progress to understanding or become weighted, bound, and merely reputational.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hearing Moves from Ear to Comprehension or Burden
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sound reaches the ear, is transmitted and understood, then either elicits compliance or is blocked by weight, binding, or ungrounded inference.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: auditory perception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); ear and auditory opening (`quranic:root_000741:B002/m01`); understanding and compliance (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); making another hear (`quranic:root_000741:B004/m01`); auditory fetter (`quranic:root_000741:B009/m01`); inference from hearing and seeing without object (`quranic:root_000741:B013/m01`); brain as auditory center (`quranic:root_000741:B016/m01`); weighted unreceptive hearing (`quranic:root_000202:B009/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hearing is decomposed into organ, event, transmission, understanding, and response. A fettered or heavy ear may receive sound without accepting it, while hasty inference treats sensory contact as knowledge before an object has been secured.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Covering Establishes the Stakes of Disclosure and Exposure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A cover creates an interior that may protect, hide, or entomb; lifting or losing it changes the occupant’s vulnerability and public status.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Unseen knowledge, armor, grave, grove, fruit-husk, uncovered defect, open hostility, exposed terrace, and abandoned child occupy distinct positions in one cover-removal mechanism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Casting Out Produces the Open and Unprotected
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An occupant is thrown from a containing relation into a side-place or bare expanse, where abandonment and lack of cover become the decisive state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: casting away (`quranic:root_001466:B001/m01`); moving to a side (`quranic:root_001466:B004/m01`); abandoned child (`quranic:root_001466:B007/m01`); neglected weak animal or scattered earth (`quranic:root_001466:B009/m01`); stripped body or land (`quranic:root_001005:B003/m01`); uncovered open ground (`quranic:root_001005:B004/m01`); abandonment without aid (`quranic:root_001005:B009/m01`); roof without parapet (`quranic:root_000015:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:46 `أَجْرًا` [ء ج ر]; 68:49 `نُبِذَ` [ن ب ذ] and `عَرَآءِ` [ع ر ي].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Exposure is produced by an operation: remove from hand or group, place at the side, strip the cover, and leave without support. The open plain in 68:49 is thus social abandonment and architectural defenselessness as well as terrain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Joined Parts Create Load-Bearing and Water-Handling Systems
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Cutting, joining, tying, and fitting convert separate materials into containers, conduits, rigging, and frames that can carry load or govern flow.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Stitched hide, tanning bark, sandal strap, bucket handle, well-rope splice, underground channel, body joint, shin, and tool-leg share an engineering logic of fitted parts under tension.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Body and Implement Share a Supporting Frame
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Back muscles, bones, joints, shin, and bodily mass bear weight in the same structural positions as an upright tool-part or standing support.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: back muscles flanking the spine (`quranic:root_001396:B003/m01`); finger, foot, and hoof bones and joints (`quranic:root_000737:B010/m01`); shin or load-bearing plant stem (`quranic:root_000762:B003/m01`); bodily mass and frame (`quranic:root_000239:B007/m01`); upright part of pulley, sword, bed, table, animal, or plough (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); burden borne in the body (`quranic:root_000202:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Anatomy and implement are analogized by load path rather than appearance alone. Jointed bones articulate, the shin stands, back musculature stabilizes, and an upright fitted part transfers force through a tool or frame.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Ground Surface Controls Posture, Footing, and Exposure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Surface composition and elevation determine whether a body can stand, lower itself, move securely, find cover, or remain publicly exposed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Hard and soft stone, low dead earth, bare expanse, slick soil, hoof-protecting gait, mountain-center, hidden grove, floor cushion, and parapetless roof make bodily posture a property of terrain and shelter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Shelter Distinguishes a Protected Interior from an Open Edge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person moves between grove, hiding-place, floor cushion, bare land, and an unguarded roof, each position supplying or removing a different kind of enclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: roof without parapet (`quranic:root_000015:B003/m01`); hiding-place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); concealing grove (`quranic:root_001117:B003/m01`); cushion cast on the floor for sitting (`quranic:root_001466:B008/m01`); stripped body or land (`quranic:root_001005:B003/m01`); uncovered open ground (`quranic:root_001005:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cover is spatially graded. Grove and hiding-place obscure the occupant, a cushion supports an interior posture, the bare plain removes enclosure, and a roof without parapet raises the body while leaving its edge unprotected.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiden bilgi edinmek için ona yönelmeyi ve bir şeyi ondan istemeyi aynı dalda açıkça tanımlar. Doğrudan nesne alan kullanım istek bildirmeye, bir konu ya da kişiyle kurulan ilgeçli kullanımlar ise bilgi edinmeye yönelir; çok soran kişi ve yardım isteyen yoksul için kullanılan adlar bu eylem çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sorma ve isteme eylemlerini kapsar; istenen şeyin kendisini, isteğin karşılanmasını ve karşılıklı sormayı ayrı dallara bırakır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem çekirdeğini korurken, doğrudan bir şeyi isteme ile bir konu veya kişi hakkında bilgi sorma kalıplarını ayrı uygulamalar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yönelerek ondan bir şey isteme ya da bir konu, nesne veya kişi hakkında bilgi edinmeye çalışma eylemidir. Doğrudan nesneli istek ve ilgeçli bilgi sorusu bu çekirdeğin farklı kuruluşlarıdır; çok soran veya yardım isteyen kişiye verilen adlar eylemden türeyen kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir muhataba yönelip bilgi edinmeye veya bir şeyi elde etmeye çalışma eylemini bildirir.
Bir şeyi doğrudan muhataptan isteme ile bir konu ya da kişi hakkında bilgi sorma, eylemin farklı söz dizimsel kuruluşlarıdır.
Çok soru soran kimse ve gereksinimini bildirerek yardım isteyen yoksul, eylemi yapan kişi olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sorma ve isteme eylemlerini birlikte verir; doğrudan nesneli kullanımda bir şey istenirken, bir konu veya kişi hakkında kurulan kullanımda bilgi aranır. Eylem adı, çok soran kimse ve yardım isteyen kişi de aynı tanıklık kümesinde yer alır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir iyilik umarak kendini gösterme veya açıkça istemeden beklenti içinde bulunma biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, bir insanın gerçekten istediği şey olarak tanımlar ve onu yalnızca zihinde tasarlanan bir dilekten ayırır. Bu nedenle dalın kimliği isteme eylemi değil, isteğin yöneldiği nesne veya karşılanması beklenen içeriktir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, kişi tarafından istenmiş olan şeyle sınırlıdır; henüz istek olarak ortaya konmamış dilek ve isteme eyleminin kendisi kapsam dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, herhangi bir özel kalıba bağlı olmadan, kişi tarafından istenen şeyi yalın dal anlamı olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın istediği, kendisine verilmesini ya da gerçekleşmesini talep ettiği şeydir. Bir dileğe yakın olabilir, ancak burada belirleyici olan onun gerçekten istenmiş olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin isteme eylemine konu ettiği şeyi veya karşılanmasını istediği içeriği belirtir.
Dileğe yaklaşır, fakat yalnızca tasarlanan olasılığı değil, kişi tarafından istek olarak ortaya konmuş şeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kavramı insanın istediği şey olarak tanımlar. Dilekle ortak bir arzu alanı bulunsa da, bu dalın ayırıcı sınırı söz konusu şeyin kişi tarafından gerçekten istenmiş olmasıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin açıkça istediği nesne, sonuç veya karşılanacak içerik için dalın tamamını doğal ve kısa biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İsteğin yöneldiği şeyi ve onun kişi tarafından istenmiş olma koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dilekle yakınlığın yanında, dileğin açık bir isteğe dönüşmüş olduğu özellikle belirtilmek istendiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dileğe yakınlığı ve bunun yalnızca tasarı olarak kalmayıp istek konusu olmasını birlikte korur.
Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesine yönelik arzu ve beklenti yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Henüz bir kimseden istenmemiş, yalnızca zihinde tasarlanmış arzuları da kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir türemiş kuruluşu, başka bir kişinin isteğini veya gereksinimini karşılamak anlamında açıkça tanımlar. Dal, istekte bulunma eylemini ya da istenen şeyi değil, isteğe cevap veren kişinin gerçekleştirdiği karşılama sonucunu merkez alır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca tanıklanan türemiş kuruluşta geçerlidir ve bir başkasının isteğini karşılama eylemiyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kökün genel anlamına yayılmaz; yalnızca tanıklanan türemiş ifadede bir başkasının isteğini veya gereksinimini karşılama anlamını verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkasının istediği şeyi yapmak, ona gerekeni sağlamak ve böylece isteğini veya gereksinimini karşılamaktır. Bu anlam genel kök anlamı değil, tanıklanan türemiş kuruluşun özel işlevidir.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin isteğini yerine getirerek onun gereksinimini karşılamayı bildirir.
Karşılama anlamı, genel sorma eylemine değil, kaynakta tanıklanan türemiş ifadeye özgüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, türemiş ifadeyi bir başkasının isteğini veya gereksinimini karşılama şeklinde açıklar. Bu, talepte bulunanın eyleminden ayrı olarak, talebe cevap veren kişinin gerçekleştirdiği sonuçlu eylemdir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tanıklanan türemiş kuruluşta, başka bir kişinin istediği şeyi yapma veya gereksinimini karşılama anlamının tamamı için uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir topluluğun üyelerinin birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini açıkça bildirir. Karşılıklılık yalnızca aynı ortamda birden çok soru bulunması değildir; katılımcıların soran ve kendisine sorulan rollerini birbirlerine göre üstlenmesi dalın kurucu özelliğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı soru yöneltmeyi gerektirir; tek kişinin başkasına yönelttiği ve karşı taraftan soru gelmeyen kullanım genel sorma dalında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tanıklanan biçimin yalın dal anlamını karşılıklı soru yöneltme olarak verir ve başka konuşma alışverişlerini bu anlama katmaz.

concept_map.definition: İki veya daha çok kişinin birbirlerine soru yöneltmesi, böylece her birinin ötekine göre soran ve kendisine sorulan konumlarına girmesidir. Yalnızca tek yönlü bir soru bu karşılıklılık koşulunu karşılamaz.

facets.statement: Birden çok katılımcının birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini ve soru rollerini karşılıklı üstlenmesini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, biçimi kişilerin birbirlerine soru sorması olarak açıklar. Bu açıklama, genel soru eylemine karşılıklı katılım ve rollerin katılımcılar arasında değişmesi koşulunu ekler.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı soru yöneltmeyi ve bu yolla bilgi edinme amacını bağlam içinde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birden çok konuşanın aynı konuda karşılıklı iletişim kurmasını içerir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Mevcut dal tek bir kavram tanımlamaz; yıpranarak incelme, çizgili görünüm, kılıç yüzeyi parıltısı ve et kaybıyla oluklaşma ayrı anlam çekirdekleridir.

facets.statement: Kumaşın kullanımdan dolayı incelip gevşemesi bağımsız bir yıpranma anlamıdır.

Dokumadaki çizgili süs bağımsız bir desen anlamıdır.
Etin azalıp bedende oluklar oluşması bağımsız bir zayıflama görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yapılan işten doğan yararlı karşılığı ana anlam olarak verir ve bunun dünyalık ödeme, manevi ödül, kiralama bedeli, evlilikte kadına verilen bedel ve ücret karşılığı çalıştırma gibi gerçekleşmelerini açıkça kapsar. Hazırlık çerçevesi bu katmanları aynı yararlı karşılık çekirdeğine bağlı tuttuğu için branch kimliği kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca yararlı bir dönüşü kapsar; zararlı karşılık ve ceza bu branchin sınırları dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak yararlı karşılık çekirdeğini verir; kiralama, işçi tutma, evlilik bedeli ve çocuk ölümüyle ilgili kullanımları yalnızca kendi biçim veya kuruluşlarına bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin yapılması veya bir anlaşmanın kurulması nedeniyle kişiye dönen yararlı karşılıktır; bu karşılık dünyalık bir ödeme ya da manevi ve öte dünyaya ilişkin bir ödül olabilir. Kiralama bedeli, ücretle çalıştırma ve evlilikte kadına verilen bedel bu çekirdeğin belirli ilişkilere bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Yapılan bir iş nedeniyle işi yapan kişiye yarar olarak dönen karşılıktır.
Karşılık, dünyalık bir ödeme, kiralama bedeli veya hizmet sözleşmesinde verilen bedel olabilir.
Karşılık, iyi bir iş için bu dünyada veya öte dünyada beklenen manevi ödül olabilir.
Evlilik ilişkisinde kadına verilmesi gereken bedel de yararlı karşılık olarak adlandırılır.
Bir kişiyi bedel karşılığında çalıştırmak üzere tutma ve o kişiyi çalışan kılma ilişkisini de kapsar.
Ölen çocukların, anne veya baba için öte dünyaya ilişkin bir ödüle dönüşmesi özel bir kuruluşta anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tablosunda ana unsur, iş veya anlaşma sonucunda kişiye yarar sağlayan bir karşılığın dönmesidir. Bu karşılık ödül, çalışma ya da kiralama bedeli ve evlilikte kadına verilen bedel biçiminde gerçekleşebilir; ayrıca birini bedel karşılığı çalışan olarak tutma ilişkisine ve ölen çocukların manevi ödül sayıldığı özel kuruluşa uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kırık kemiğin birleştirilmesini genel çekirdek olarak verirken diğer aktarımlar eğri, çıkıntılı veya düzgün olmayan biçimde kaynamayı özellikle belirtir. Uyak harflerinin farklılığı da bağımsız bir çekirdek değil, düzensiz birleşmeye dayandırılan teknik bir uzantıdır. Bu nedenle hazırlık çerçevesi kullanılabilir, fakat bütün örnekleri yalnızca eğri kaynamaya indirgememek gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel kırık onarımı çekirdektir; eğri kaynama güçlü bir uzmanlaşma, uyak uyuşmazlığı ise buna bağlı teknik uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kırığın birleştirilmesi çekirdeğini korur; eğri kaynama belirli biçim ve kuruluşlarda öne çıkar, uyak anlamıysa yalnızca şiir tekniğine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Kırılmış kemik ya da elin birleştirilip kaynamasıdır; birçok kullanımda eğri, çıkıntılı veya düzgün olmayan bir biçimde iyileşme özellikle belirtilir. Şiirde karşılık gelen uyak harflerinin farklı olması, bu düzensiz birleşmeye benzetilen teknik bir uzantıdır.

facets.statement: Kırılmış kemiği veya eli birleştirme ve yeniden kaynatma sürecini anlatır.
Birleşen kemiğin eğri, çıkıntılı ya da düzgün olmayan biçimde kaynaması birçok kullanımın belirleyici koşuludur.
Şiirde karşılık gelen uyakların farklı harflerle bitmesi, düzensiz kaynamaya benzetilen teknik bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kırık kemiğin veya elin birleştirilmesini ortak zemin olarak sunar; bazı aktarımlar sonucu özellikle eğri, çıkıntılı ya da düzgün olmayan kaynama olarak sınırlar. Uyaklarda denk konumlardaki harflerin farklı olması da bu fiziksel düzensizlikten türetilmiş teknik bir kullanım olarak açıklanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi referenti açıkça çevresinde koruyucu duvar bulunmayan dam yüzeyi olarak tanımlar. Bölgesel kullanım kaydı ile zayıf veya düzeltilmesi gereken bir söyleyiş biçimi referentin kimliğini değiştirmez, yalnızca sözcüğün kullanım ve biçim sınırlarını gösterir. Hazırlık çerçevesi bu ayrımı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Branch yalnızca çevresi duvar veya korkulukla kapatılmamış damı kapsar; genel çatı ve yapı taşı anlamları kapsam dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım korkuluksuz dam referentini korur; bölgesel biçimler, çoğullar ve düzeltilen söyleyişler ayrı lexical birimlere bağlıdır ve genel bir kök anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yapının üstünde bulunan ve çevresinde koruyucu duvar ya da korkuluk olmayan açık dam yüzeyidir. Sözcük bazı bölgelere özgü sayılır; aktarılan başka bir söyleyiş biçimi ise zayıf veya düzeltilmesi gereken biçim olarak değerlendirilir.

facets.statement: Yapının üstünde yer alan ve çevresinde koruyucu duvar veya korkuluk bulunmayan dam yüzeyidir.
Kullanımın belirli bölgelere ait olduğu ve kırsal konuşmanın genel bir parçası olmadığı aktarılır.
Başında ek bir ünsüz bulunan söyleyiş, zayıf bir bölgesel biçim veya düzeltilmesi gereken kullanım sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tanımı çevresinde koruyucu duvar bulunmayan bir dam yüzeyidir. Kullanım belirli bölgelere bağlanır ve genel kırsal söz varlığına ait olmadığı belirtilir; farklı bir söyleyiş biçimi de kimi aktarımda zayıf, kiminde düzeltilmesi gereken biçim olarak değerlendirilir.

concept_map.definition: Kulakta veya işitmede ağırlık, yani kulağın kendisine yöneltilen sesi veya sözü almakta zorlanması ve işitmenin zayıflamasıdır.

facets.statement: Kulak, kendisine gelen şeyi kabul etmekte zorlanır ve işitme zayıflar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak dalı tek bir işitme bağlamında verir: kulakta ağırlık vardır ve bu ağırlık, işitmenin kendisine geleni kolayca alamaması şeklinde anlaşılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal işitmenin ağırlaşması ve geleni almakta zorlanmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal işitmenin gitmesi, sağırlık ve bazen dinlememe tavrıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal işitme eksikliğinde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal zayıflama veya ağırlık düzeyinde kalabilir; komşu dal tam sağırlığa ve mecazi dinlememe tavrına kadar genişler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kulağın kabulde ağırlaşmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kulağın söze yönelmesi ve sesi alma sahasını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal alımın zayıflığını belirtir; komşu dal alıma yönelme ve dikkatli dinleme yönündedir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök ailesi ağırlık çekirdeğinden hareketle maddi ağır gelme, taşınan yük, günah sorumluluğu, tartı ölçüsü, değer ve itibar, bedensel halsizlik, gebelik, kadın betimi ve işitme zayıflığı alanlarına ayrılır. Dallar ortak ağırlık imgesini paylaşır, fakat her biri nesne, ölçü, ahlak, beden, değer veya duyu sınırıyla ayrılaşır.
